def line_words(rs):
    c = collections.Counter()
    tot = 0
    for r in rs:
        toks = r['text'].split()
        tot += len(toks)
        for line in r['text'].split('\n'):
            w = line.strip().split(' ')[0] if line.strip() else ''
            c[w]+=1
    return c, tot

# also just word freq
def wordfreq(rs):
    c = collections.Counter(); tot=0
    for r in rs:
        toks = r['text'].split(); tot+=len(toks); c.update(toks)
    return c, tot

common = set(wc)|set(wd)
